response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM c), g AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_avg FROM s) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share_minus_avg FROM g WHERE share_minus_avg > 0 ORDER BY share_minus_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Observatories are the stations that appear in telescopes, so stations with no telescopes are not counted. This affects the average share, because the average is taken over those stations.
Ties at the top-10 cutoff are broken arbitrarily. Share and the gap are not rounded.

alternatives.interpretation: Every station in the observatories table counts as an observatory, including stations with zero telescopes. The average share is then 1 divided by the number of all stations.
alternatives.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories o LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM c), g AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_avg FROM s) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share_minus_avg FROM g WHERE share_minus_avg > 0 ORDER BY share_minus_avg DESC LIMIT 10
